candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement to return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Change the return statement to always return the zero address.
Change the return statement to return the roundImplementation-typed zero unless owner set, by returning the negated check result cast to address: return _owner != address(0) ? _owner : _msgSender();
Change the return statement to return the transaction origin instead of the stored owner.
Delete the require statement validating the new owner is not the zero address.
Replace the ownership transfer call with a transfer to the zero address.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can transfer ownership.
Delete the internal ownership transfer so the owner never changes.
Removed the zero-address require so roundImplementation can be set to address(0).
Assigns alloSettings instead of newRoundImplementation to roundImplementation.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can update roundImplementation.
